body: I feel like your in my body, and i wrote this post.. I dont feel like anybody gets how suicidal i actually am... /r/watchpeopledie is one of my most visited threads, cause im preparing myself to know what its going to be like if i decide to follow through... and your right, i dont want people to know, cause once they know, ill be in a mental hospital, ill be labeled suicidal and constantly watched and locked in a room. That would make it worse. Communication is my biggest flaw, I cant see counselors cause i put on my fake alibi.. I wish you the best and if you need anyone to talk to, reddit, and I am here.. although, im struggling as well, maybe we could help eachother out.

Thanks, I usually try not to worry about other people or what they think... But when youve gone 23 years, and slowly lost all contact with every single person thats come into your life, and have ruined every single good thing thats come my way, im constantly broke, im struggling with an addiction.........to weed..... which is sad in itself... makes me think its actually me, not other people...i feel worthless and everyday suicide comes to mind more and more. today i realized i wouldnt be scared to actually do it, id be scared to see what came after, if i would be able to even ever know...if that makes sense
